name: V1
summary: Ready for a real, shippable v1. The design layer turns on (PRINCIPLES.md #3): three-layer design tokens enforced via design-drift-loop, ui-designer + ux-designer as visual+flow authorities, db-architect for real data shape. /board for cross-FEAT sequencing, /design-review before code, /ux-check after, and /design-library — the visual system you can actually look at: one self-contained HTML page with the foundations, the RULE SETS (principles+tradeoffs, rendered do/don't pairs, terminology, voice) and every component in all five states, generated from the code so it cannot drift, with a manifest that doubles as the agent's reuse index and a source-hash staleness check; drift renders ON the component instead of in a report nobody reopens. Plus the next tier of mentors: business (model + pricing), fundraising (whether/when/how), pitch (story + deck), talent (first hires + cadence) — promoted from BOSS-local in v0.15.0 to scaffolded-project templates here.
graduationHint: When the team grows, the org gets real, and the product council needs to be a thing — boss unlock scale.
